prefix: The daemon startup constructs the native
text: The daemon startup constructs the native `iroha_sumeragi` driver; remaining old consumers are being retired. The [native quorum checkpoint](docs/history/2026-09-27/validator-staking-native-quorum.md) records 329 ordinary simulator/library passes and both opt-in passes at the earlier cut, then 330 ordinary passes and the additional recovery-halt mutation kill at the later cut. All six selected strict mutations were killed in their recorded source cuts; the opt-ins still require a later-source rerun. Global schedule/genesis/history checks enforce bounded exact `3f + 1` membership; the generic core rejects over-quorum certificates. The schedule now retains authenticated original roster/PoPs, and publication recovery halts the sole driver. The retained publication path passes a focused production Core check; the next native unit selection passes 115 and fails one all-zero BLS test seed, now repaired with its focused rerun passing. Four Cell successor, fourteen MV original-read/custody and three Core trigger checks pass in their recorded cuts. The earlier scoped staking suite finished 145/5 and its fixture contracts are repaired. Direct field placement repairs the reproduced World aggregate stack overflow; the snapshot decoder also now reaches strict custody validation on the original stack. The current full MV suite passes 284 tests, Core original controls pass 6 and the original prefix/custody regressions pass. Earlier allocator and canonical privacy-admission checks pass on their recorded inputs. The broader 183-test run stopped after 174 passes and 7 failures with a snapshot stack abort. Three admission/lifecycle fixture repairs pass focused reruns; canonical-XOR, additive reserve, snapshot, penalty and opaque-fee fixture repairs are rebuilding. Deferred publication passes 5 of 7 focused tests; two stale consumed-owner refund expectations are corrected, with a test-only census-scope compile repair pending. Complete allocation/lock lifecycle and unchanged-candidate qualification remain open. Two release-fixture failures in the earlier 109/2 model selection are repaired with authenticated regeneration and five focused assertion passes; profiles pass 23/23 and codecs pass 15 with one opt-in unrun. The [Sumeragi goals](specs/sumeragi_goals.md) retain the full staking, signed RS16, original funded execution and liveness requirements across the rewrite. The native epoch producer, barrier, restore and original World controls pass the Core library check. Mandatory signed control, pure Pasta verification, original signing receipts and direct legacy-owner retirement remain staged and unqualified. Real network, full formal/DA, workspace and SDK qualification remain open. Earlier simulator evidence in the [rewrite record](docs/history/2026-09-25/sumeragi-rewrite.md) does not qualify this integrated candidate.

prefix: The merge composes the prepared World/runtime publisher
text: The merge composes the prepared World/runtime publisher with the canonical ordinary and native execution owner. Publication requires original journals, exact execution witness, immutable output surface, verified CommitQC and matching durable Kura finality. Native recorded execution retains the pristine QueuePlan/NPoS control owner and an authenticated height context bound to the original State, generation, parent and committed policies; suffix contexts use that authority. Shared AXT/DA/SCCP postchecks precede one witness capture. Sources retain the complete carrier, including controls, and strict scratch refuses unsupported controls. Snapshot restore receives the frozen manifest baseline before rebuilding derived state, retains exact catalog descriptions and validates ledger reduction metadata without changing restored World. Executable MergeQC sources are rejected; completed-history economics and replay denial use real native Decisions. The private terminal publisher consumes original ordinary or single/atomic Native journals and the exact checkpoint under one State visibility interval. The current candidate carries one joint Kura lease through source authentication, witness staging/promotion, archive persistence and final proof authentication before State writers. Storage refusal retains the original owner for exact retry. The [retained capture and publication owner](docs/history/2026-09-20/retained-capture-and-target.md) now returns incomplete archive capture, validated, decided or checkpointed execution to the same preallocated candidate slot. Incomplete capture cannot mint a marker; captured State/header identity is checked before derived publication writes. Build108 passed the seven-package test build, 192 runtime regressions and 179 source-contract controls with the canonical gate on matched source manifests. The next checkpoint lends the original producer alongside the selected phase and exposes every retained candidate field to admission, including original deferred-record/event capacities. Capture retries retain their original boxed allocation; ready phases skip consuming resume. Its fresh validation receipts and source-manifest join are recorded separately in the capture record. Production now uses the retained Validate owner; complete allocation admission and retirement qualification remain open. The [participant publication custody](docs/history/2026-09-21/participant-publication-custody.md) change binds the readback token to its original Kura and reauthenticates exact durable participant evidence before live State staging; its scoped qualification is recorded there. The new Native Decision path owns separate sealed application markers and requires the old participant manifest to be empty; its production cutover remains open. The [B+tree lifetime correction](docs/history/2026-09-20/bptree-allocation-lifetimes.md) removes partial-clone, separator and constructor ownership defects in the actual storage dependency. Its eight-package build, storage/MV/Core regressions and formal controls pass on matched captured source; the dated record identifies the exact scope and receipt. The subsequent [linear allocation custody](docs/history/2026-09-20/linear-allocation-custody.md) attaches charges to exact original cursor/reader control blocks through real deallocation, unlocks before refund callbacks, and removes allocation from final-tree teardown and first release notification. [Refund notification custody](docs/history/2026-09-20/refund-notification-custody.md) now preserves surviving waiters across callback unwind and defers same-thread pool wakeups until a synchronous operation unlocks, while returning freed credits immediately. The [prepaid writer/node boundary](docs/history/2026-09-20/prepaid-writer-and-node-custody.md) now carries original constructor input under admission and typed credits through actual padded node allocation/reclamation. The [charged cursor/retirement boundary](docs/history/2026-09-20/charged-cursor-retirement.md) now carries typed funding and original fixed bookkeeping through the same insertion engine and reader retirement, refuses insufficient slots before mutation, and removes mutable aliases from shared traversal/clone probes. The [payload-cloning boundary](docs/history/2026-09-20/prepaid-payload-cloning.md) now requires the original provider's explicit policy for all node-owned copies, including separators. The [closed insertion boundary](docs/history/2026-09-20/closed-admitted-insertion.md) now admits complete planned node/buffer/shell/payload-copy demand under the original map lock and returns a completed detached successor, releasing unused admission before handoff. The [retained edit extension](docs/history/2026-09-20/retained-admitted-edits.md) keeps multiple admitted edits in one original private cursor and charges its initial root allocation. The [borrowed checkpoint](docs/history/2026-09-20/borrowed-map-checkpoints.md) now restores the original parent root and tracking buffers without rollback allocation; caught mutation or cleanup panic forbids partial publication. Its scoped validation is recorded separately. The [native Storage undo owner](docs/history/2026-09-20/native-storage-undo.md) now uses the same tree for current and block-undo generations, preserving original snapshots and retry ownership without cloning prior undo on ordinary block opening. The [Storage transaction checkpoints](docs/history/2026-09-20/storage-transaction-checkpoints.md) now restore both original parent trees on abort without cloning, allocation or inverse edits, and borrow transaction preimages directly. Joint current/undo/touch admission is implemented below; generation-refusal propagation through State remains open. Production World maps remain untracked; native lock/runtime storage, concrete model payloads and the configured aggregate policy remain unfinished. The [funded snapshot restoration](docs/history/2026-09-21/admitted-storage-restoration.md) reconstructs exact current/undo images and lends generic borrowed history under the original pool. Checkpoint135 passed both 268-test MV layouts plus doctests, 58 Core review regressions and the 220-test release gate on matched captured inputs. The [funded publication identities](docs/history/2026-09-21/funded-publication-identities.md) now reserve successor storage before execution and retain original charges through final identity release; both full MV layouts pass 272 runtime tests plus a doctest, Concread passes 428, and the release gate passes 220 tests plus 2,654 subtests. Fresh Core unit-test compilation and all 58 original review regressions pass on the same compiler inputs. The [funded detached Storage handoff](docs/history/2026-09-21/funded-detached-storage.md) now preserves original admitted journals across capture and exact retry, confines physical preparation to its original pool scope, and releases both capture/abort writers before either native retry notification. Both MV layouts pass 278 runtime tests and five doctests; the release harness passes 220 tests and 2,678 subtests. Fresh Core test compilation, all 58 original review regressions and 106 affected State publication controls pass on matching compiler inputs; the shipping library check passes with eight existing warnings. The [executing-block ownership correction](docs/history/2026-09-21/executing-block-abandonment.md) extends paired release from prepared publication through ordinary/admitted opening, replacement, execution and snapshot restore; both writers release before native callbacks and retain actual mutex poison through payload/wake unwind. Its MV layouts each pass 283 runtime tests plus five doctests; the corrected release harness passes 220 tests plus 2,698 subtests. The [native reader-readiness correction](docs/history/2026-09-21/native-reader-readiness.md) now binds hash retries to the actual blocking mutex and retains published reader notifications through cleanup; it removes writer-release self-wakes. The [component preparation correction](docs/history/2026-09-21/prepared-component-retirement.md) now retains native map/Cell preparation and identity before transfer, and keeps successful World/runtime/membership cleanup through the State fences. Successful retained-carrier completion preserves original State/Kura/Queue notifications until commit unlock; [fully acquired carrier abort](docs/history/2026-09-21/prepared-component-abort.md) now retains component cleanup through those fences on explicit abort and Drop. [Returned preparation refusals](docs/history/2026-09-21/prepared-refusal-cleanup.md) now retain MV, runtime, TriggerSet and World cleanup through their enclosing consumer. [Prepared runtime/trigger abandonment](docs/history/2026-09-21/prepared-aggregate-abandonment.md) now releases every sibling writer before callbacks on Drop and unwind while retaining both capacity owners. Acquisition panic, earlier State/Kura/Queue probes, successor notifications, complete State effect preparation and production admission/cutover remain open. These scoped checks do not close production integration or network qualification. The [admitted Storage replacement](docs/history/2026-09-21/admitted-storage-replacement.md) now preserves both committed roots on capacity or planning refusal and retains original funded preimages through replacement and publication retry; its focused validation remains distinct from production cutover. Retained nonretiring lifecycle now completes its original storage attempt before visibility and publishes its captured manifest/reset effects within that same generation. The seven-package build and 159 distinct focused Rust controls pass on unchanged epoch101 inputs. Source-contract and structural outcomes, including the corrected raw-token formatting failure, retain their separate captured scope in the publication record. Retirement/replacement still requires the original service Queue cut, and nonempty old participant obligations remain refused before visibility. Physical retries still reconstruct identical witness staging; production resource admission must account for or eliminate that work. Recorded native execution alone grants no ValidBlock, resource, publication or Apply authority. The [joint Storage admission](docs/history/2026-09-20/joint-storage-admission.md) now reserves current/first-undo/touch storage together and retains both publication participants through joint identity installation before charge cleanup or release callbacks. The same release ordering now covers EBR-backed Cells and current-only replacement. Its 217-test qualification includes post-publication cleanup panic followed by healthy-lock contention, direct insertion and reentrant Cell release. The subsequent [allocation-free State scans](docs/history/2026-09-21/allocation-free-state-scans.md) remove MV iterator boxes and both dynamic B+tree read paths; exact current normal/ASAN, consumer-build, Core and formal evidence is retained in the linked records. The [closed admitted removal](docs/history/2026-09-21/closed-admitted-removal.md) now funds bounded path/sibling/separator copies in the original engine and preserves exact checkpoint rollback; [Joint Storage removal](docs/history/2026-09-21/joint-storage-removal.md) now shares complete admission with insertion and preserves explicit first-absence/touch witnesses, returned-value custody and rollback. Both full MV layouts pass 231 runtime controls and one documentation test, and production Core compiles; the linked record retains exact scope and the failed test-fixture attempt. The [shared BlockHashes integration](docs/history/2026-09-21/shared-block-history.md) replaces block/query history copies with original immutable tree generations, releases private hash writers before World acquisition, and authenticates publication against the real root/predecessor. Its prepaid checkpoint adds one configured original hash pool, hidden-tip construction before World and typed release-driven refusal through validation and proposal construction. Shipping checks, the nine-package test build and 283 Core, 32 consumer, 224 MV and 888 Config controls pass with exact final executable joins; the linked record preserves fixture corrections, scoped formal/vendor evidence and original failed captures. Broader production funding/work and network qualification remain open.

prefix: The next Sumeragi cutover must carry
text: The next Sumeragi cutover must carry the implemented consuming State publisher and exact retained output owner through the complete production Validate-to-Apply path, including cached/recovered markers and voting; preserve one original execution per exact subject. The single I/O worker must retain a move-only prepared entry bound to its service's original State/Queue pair. Carry the implemented retained-carrier phase owner through live cache and reproposal; refusal retains original incomplete capture, validated, decided or checkpointed execution and capacity in one candidate slot without reconstructing a ValidBlock. Complete archive capture before marker authority and authenticate the captured State/header before derived writes; carry the same wrapper-owned Apply service from cold revalidation through worker launch. Cold unfinished recovery builds it once before restoring markers, while already-applied recovery repairs durable completion without executing again. Preserve the implemented explicit semantic/storage verdict boundary: Kura, planner storage and committed DA hydration failures cannot persist rejection authority. Reserve complete capture capacity before detachment. Preserve the implemented physical Validate retry: original dispatch/index, actual mutex and worker-capacity release notification, and authenticated ordinary-completion drain. Qualify consuming Apply/publication retry around the original prepared owner, including one continuous Kura lease across source authentication, witness/archive persistence and State preparation under a competing advert reader; reproduce the latest three-replica genesis stall and require all validators to finish before the Native outage. Fixed local capacity and pending retirement promises remain non-verdict operational refusals. Preserve the shared State retained-admission authority across Queue recovery and Native closed-lane opening. Qualify the implemented Torii canonical-custody retry before fresh routing/capacity, its complete historical-read workspace and original deadline. Carry the implemented authentication-only canonical retry and its current-policy/forged-signature/absent-input controls into full qualification. Qualify the shared single/batch certified admission owner, ordered partial outcomes and exact duplicate retries; migrate the remaining generic economic adapters without restoring the removed ordinary batch writer. Qualify the implemented release-driven canonical Queue cleanup for ordinary selection owners; complete remaining autonomous terminal cleanup without consuming Kura Pending as Complete, and qualify the implemented canonical-only public QueuePlan 202 and exact committed-close terminalization of uncarried claims under delayed receipts, partial attempts and restart. Queue retirement still needs a fully shared authenticated predicate and a drain protocol that does not require the blocked height: a local pending-work wait alone can deadlock and is not a consensus-validity rule. Keep original World/runtime journals, source groups, witness, result bytes, exact lease-bound checkpoint receipt and verified QC/Kura authority joined before visibility. Keep the original World wrapper/vector allocations through refusal and abort, and share each accepted Native context across body and retirement handoffs; fund initial construction and execution before their allocations occur. Carry the implemented joint current/first-preimage/touch admission and staged pair publication through concrete model policies and general closed mutation/replacement; preserve the implemented joint removal, first-absence/touch witnesses and original returned-value custody; preserve the locally qualified prepaid BlockHashes construction/edit path and original release-driven retry, then complete its native runtime provisioning and network qualification; preserve allocation-free borrowed State scans, fund native runtime and identity storage, bound touch-shifting work, and propagate generation refusal through State while preserving allocation-free abort, no-op, absent-key and replacement history. Carry the pristine QueuePlan/NPoS control owner, authenticated applying context through suffix finalization and common AXT/DA/SCCP postchecks into the canonical validator while preserving State generation and complete carrier custody. Preserve the implemented nonretiring geometry completion and retained lifecycle effects in the consuming publisher. Retain the implemented Queue cut and original Kura guards through remaining Queue retirement; bind them to the exact State/Queue pair from V2ApplyService and keep later State/component acquisition try-only. Preserve original-Kura participant reauthentication for the remaining scalar AMX writer until its consumers migrate and the old participant representation is retired. The new Native Decision owner already seals its own application markers; do not make activation depend on accepting the retired nonempty participant manifest or rejected MergeQC sources. Bind complete mandatory framing and signed RS16 feasibility to admission before durable receipts; preserve authenticated startup refusal of local capacity below signed RS16 and the live pre-receipt native/publication envelope checks. Complete the guaranteed global admission opportunity: bound mandatory metadata across policy changes and each admitted evidence envelope. Preserve the exact optional-evidence fitter, height-based class opportunity and original-ledger cold restoration; finish bounded evidence-pool refill and startup scan cost. Autonomous anchors bind their original global height and cannot simply be trimmed into a later carrier; connect their reachable next action through the shared lane owner. The protocol input cap alone is insufficient. Finish bounded pre-vote descriptor/capacity admission, capture, file-handle and installation resources, and reachable typed deferral. Capacity scanning must precede geometry/sidecar acquisition; public geometry/GC/history wrappers cannot run under the held joint lease. Preserve original route-directory custody during retirement and account for witness staging on physical retries. Keep obsolete State observations as typed refreshes, including a finalized height advance, and preserve independent beacon and key-lifecycle behavior. Complete and qualify Native DA/pin/SCCP owners, broader NPoS evidence/penalty and sponsor/lease coverage before opening the live Native header gate. Replace mandatory per-route application files with one authenticated carrier proof bundle and bounded history references, retaining exact source/finality/WSV joins and whole-bundle accounting. Defer physical GC behind release, snapshot/recovery pins and an instance-local deletion fence; qualify native Windows namespace durability separately. Qualify the connected native transport, authenticated Decision candidate, process-lived shared lane reducer and canonical economic publication/Apply path; do not restore the retired fresh-signing authority. Connect the implemented process-lived Native ingress custody to the sole consumer and global-only rollover drain; preserve its original allocations, shared bounded source accounting and full shutdown drain. Connect the implemented borrowed publication proof to the original Apply consumer, including closed-instance custody and different valid quorum signer subsets. Preserve the implemented capacity-accounted retirement handoff and proof-bound terminal consumption of original closed body/control custody, including pending and fsynced Decision checks, without synthetic readiness or Apply. Preserve cross-route closure, immutable incarnation storage, drain/signing fences and historical native authority. Qualify one unchanged four/seven-validator fault/restart/final-transaction candidate and the full workspace before closing any liveness goal. Source-scoped evidence lives in [status](status.md); [superseded local plans](docs/history/2026-09-19/merge-source-publication-evidence.md) are preserved verbatim.
